title: Image caching understands more languages
summary:
Image caching got multilingual prompt matching, length-aware thresholds, and a clearer account of why a cached image was returned.

The semantic image cache switched to multilingual `bge-m3` embeddings and now compares original prompt text rather than stripping punctuation and capitalization.

A fixed similarity threshold gave way to prompt-length-dependent thresholds: 0.85 for short prompts and 0.95 for long ones. Tests also check that small but meaningful prompt changes do not become semantic cache hits.

Responses now distinguish exact from semantic hits with `X-Cache-Type` and report similarity scores for semantic hits. Analytics separates the two hit types, and the cache Worker proxies requests outside the prompt route to the image origin.
